replies.body:
Hi Lisa,

Thanks for reaching out. I had a look at My Villa — interesting approach and there are certainly some parallels in how you think about courtyards, climate and materiality.

Feel free to send me some more information on what you had in mind.

Best,
Dieter

Met vriendelijke groet,

Dieter Blok

dieter@blokarchitectuur.nl

Dieter BLOK architectuur
Stationsplein 118 
2011LN Haarlem
www.dieterblok.nl

Architectuur die het landschap versterkt



-----Oorspronkelijk bericht-----
Van: Lisa Monelli <info@myvilla.la> 
Verzonden: woensdag 12 augustus 2026 08:19
Aan: Dieter Blok <dieter@blokarchitectuur.nl>
Onderwerp: A European angle on your Modern residential exterior architecture around a courtyard piece

Hi team,

I came across your feature on modern residential exterior architecture built around a courtyard and appreciated how you framed the courtyard as both an organizing structure and a way of shaping light and privacy, rather than just a design flourish.

I'm reaching out from My Villa, where we build homes in Los Angeles using Italian construction methods, particularly reinforced concrete, or cemento a vista, left exposed as a finished material. Courtyards have long served the same purpose in Mediterranean building, quietly mediating between climate, community, and solitude, which felt closely aligned with your piece.

Would you be open to receiving more material on our approach, or perhaps a short call with our founder, Paolo Mezzalama, to talk through it further

Best,
Lisa Monelli
My Villa Media Team
info@myvilla.la · myvilla.la
